title: A Neighborhood Seed Swap
description: Compare seed packets with a neighbor and choose a few vegetables for next year's beds.
cardDescription: Compare seed packets with a neighbor and choose a few vegetables for next year's beds.
focus: Compare seed packets with a neighbor and choose a few vegetables for next year's beds.
solvingTip: Start with this clue: “Exchange one thing for another.” Its answer begins with S. Then use the crossing letters for the other scene words.
words: Small paper envelope in which seeds are often sold
Plant part from which a new plant grows
Furniture with a flat top and legs
Give part of something to others
Day and month on a calendar
Line of things side by side

answerNotes.SWAP: A swap exchanges something you have for something another gardener can share.
answerNotes.PACKET: The packet identifies the seeds inside and often gives sowing information.
answerNotes.BEAN: A bean is both an edible seed and the plant grown from it.

title: A Garden Vacation Helper
description: Leave a simple watering note so a friend can look after the pots while you are away.
cardDescription: Leave a simple watering note so a friend can look after the pots while you are away.
focus: Leave a simple watering note so a friend can look after the pots while you are away.
solvingTip: Start with this clue: “Short written message.” Its answer begins with N. Then use the crossing letters for the other scene words.
words: Container used for growing a plant
Tip liquid from one container into another
Container with a spout used for watering
Flat green part of a plant
Look over to make sure something is right

answerNotes.NOTE: A written note can identify which pots a visitor should check.
answerNotes.WATER: Watering needs can differ between pots, so this scene leaves instructions for each one.
answerNotes.FRIEND: The friend is helping with the plants while their owner is away.

Container with a base and sides
Public board with words or symbols
Give part of something to others

Sack for carrying home a few vegetables
Plants grown for food, considered collectively

answerNotes.SQUASH: Summer squash includes zucchini and the familiar yellow varieties.
answerNotes.FREE: The free sign tells neighbors they do not need to pay.
answerNotes.BOX: The box holds the extra vegetables together for visitors to choose.

title: A Plant Cutting Rooting in Water
subtheme: A Plant Cutting Rooting in Water
description: Watch for little roots on a stem cutting placed in a clear jar.
cardDescription: Watch for little roots on a stem cutting placed in a clear jar.
focus: Watch for little roots on a stem cutting placed in a clear jar.
solvingTip: Start with this clue: “Piece of plant stem used to grow a new plant.” Its answer begins with C. Then use the crossing letters for the other scene words.
words: Piece of plant stem used to grow a new plant
New plant part growing from the stem into water
Liquid in the clear rooting jar
Flat plant part still attached to the cutting
To cut away unwanted ends or edges

answerNotes.CUTTING: A cutting is a piece taken from a plant to start another.
answerNotes.ROOT: New roots may grow from a suitable cutting placed in water.
answerNotes.JAR: A clear jar makes it easier to see the new growth below the waterline.
